name: Hakan Hediye Çarkı
author: hakansalih

sections.description:
Hakan Hediye Çarkı is a modern and engaging spin-to-win gift wheel plugin designed to increase conversion rates, user engagement, and sales on your WooCommerce store.

Visitors and registered customers can spin the interactive lucky wheel to win percentage discounts, fixed cart discounts, or free shipping rewards. Won coupons can automatically be applied to the WooCommerce shopping cart.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Wheel Engine: Fully customizable prize slices, winning probability weights, and color schemes.
  • WooCommerce Coupon Integration: Automatically creates and validates unique WooCommerce discount coupons for winners.
  • Multi-Layer Security & Limits: Comprehensive protection using user ID, email address, IP subnet, and browser fingerprinting.
  • My Account Integration: Dedicated endpoint in WooCommerce My Account to track remaining spins and won coupons.
  • Smart Launcher Button: Floating launcher trigger with badge count and option to hide when user runs out of spins.
  • Modern & Fully Responsive Design: Clean interface that adapts smoothly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Vector SVG Icons: Crisp and lightweight SVG icons without external icon fonts or emojis.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hakan-gift-wheel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure slices, probabilities, and settings from the Hediye Çarkı admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for coupon generation and cart integration.

How do spin limits and cooldown periods work?

When a user reaches their spin limit, they must wait for the configured cooldown period (default is 7 days) before spinning again.

Can the wheel button be hidden for users who have used all spins?

Yes, you can enable the “Hide Wheel Button When User Has No Spins Left” option in General Settings.
